steps.title: Load the quarter's lobbying filings
steps.prose: What each client paid to ask government for, as filed. After this: one row per lobbying filing, and every count downstream is a count of these. Invented data; no real filing.
steps.data_description: Every filing in the sample, as the CSV records it.

steps.title: Load each client's public commitment
steps.prose: What each client told everyone else it would do — the promise its filings get read against. After this: one row per client, and a repeat fails the run rather than quietly multiplying filings. Also invented.
steps.data_description: Every organisation with a public commitment on record.

steps.title: Check every filing before anything reads it
steps.prose: The spend is text on the filing until someone reads it. After this: every `amount_usd` is a number, and a filing whose spend could not be read stopped the run rather than travelling as a blank.
steps.data_description: Every filing in the sample, with its reported spend read as a number.

steps.title: Join each filing to its client's public commitment
steps.prose: Puts the promise beside the ask, dropping no filing. After this: every lobbying filing is still here, and a blank `public_commitment` means the client has none on record — the absence IS the record.
steps.data_description: Every filing, plus its client's commitment where one matched.

steps.title: Judge the filing against the commitment
steps.prose: Whether an ask contradicts the client's promise is a reading, made here. After this: every filing carries `alignment` and the sentence behind it. Trust this step least — read both texts yourself.
steps.data_description: The same filings, plus the model's judgment and its one-sentence note.

steps.title: Put every contradiction in front of a person
steps.prose: A contradiction is a proposal until someone reads both texts. After this: every flagged filing carries a reviewer's `reviewed_alignment`, their name and their note; `skipped` means no person was asked.
steps.data_description: Every filing, plus the label a person left on the ones the model called contradictions.

steps.title: Publish the report
steps.prose: What you hand to someone who was not here — open it under Published, below. After this: one page per filing, each row linked back to its own lineage, each printed contradiction naming whoever reviewed it.
steps.data_description: One row per filing, as published.
